reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the sachets: one a day, tear it open with one hand, toss it in my bag. objection: 'Every batch lab-tested' with a QR code sounds like marketing, everyone says tested. I'd have to actually scan it and see a real report before I believed it, and I probably won't reorder until I feel something.
would_change_my_mind: Scanning the QR on the box and seeing a real batch report from a named lab, plus a creator I trust saying it helped her sleep.
